headlines.title: Hakeem Jeffries says he’s a ‘hard yes’ on impeaching Pete Hegseth
headlines.description: Jeffries said on ABC’s “This Week” that he supports Rep. Thomas Massie, R-Ky., in his efforts to impeach Hegseth.

headlines.title: Adam Hamilton says 'sense of common decency' fueled his historic campaign victory
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton (D-Kan.) joins Meet the Press to explain how he became the first Democrat elected to the senate in Kansas since 1932.

headlines.title: Byron Donalds on DeSantis' midterm explanation: ‘I actually don't know what' he is talking about
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Gov.-elect Byron Donalds (R-Fla.) reacts to current Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis blaming the Republican party’s midterm losses on GOP candidates misleading voters on gas prices.

headlines.title: Gov. Josh Shapiro urges Democrats to prioritize healthcare, food assistance
headlines.description: The Pennsylvania governor told NBC News’ “Meet the Press” that he hopes Medicare and SNAP programs are revitalized by Congress.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., said he supports efforts to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, which are expected to be brought to a vote this week.

headlines.title: Nvidia opens investigation after CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence
headlines.description: Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife in an employee memo. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

headlines.title: Tensions rise in Philadelphia over boycott of Jewish-owned restaurants
headlines.description: A pro-Palestinian group said it’s protesting businesses for supporting Israel. The Anti-Defamation League called it “antisemitic, plain and simple.”

headlines.title: The unlikely quarterback who beat a Patrick Mahomes record
headlines.description: The Denver Broncos’ victory was their 17th consecutive win with Bo Nix as the starter in games decided by one score or less — breaking a record held by Patrick Mahomes.

headlines.title: We want to hear your experience with changes to student loan repayment plans
headlines.description: If you’re a student borrower who was required to transition to another plan this year, share your story.

headlines.title: The human touch: Luxury brands embrace craftsmanship as ‘AI slop’ floods the internet
headlines.description: Artists say brands are embracing traditional art forms and making a point to show off the human labor behind their campaigns.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.
